description: A clock with a run button, a reset, and four divisions of its tick

params.text: Sets the tempo, about 15 to 3840 beats per minute
At the bottom of its travel nothing happens; turned up, it makes a reset more likely on any given tick
Sends a reset out and puts the divisions back to the start

outputs.text: The clock tick, a quarter note by default
A trigger when the clock is started, and whenever the random reset fires
A trigger every fourth clock tick
A trigger every eighth clock tick
A trigger every sixteenth clock tick
A trigger every thirty-second clock tick

menu: 1/4 Notes, 1/8 Notes, 1/16 Notes, 1/32 Notes and 1/64 Notes — set the rate of the clock output against the tempo
Gate Length — sets how long each clock pulse lasts, in milliseconds
Reset Pulse Length — sets how long the reset pulse lasts, in milliseconds
